artworks.title: Grosse Walchenseelandschaft (Large Walchen Sea Landscape)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a mountain range along the horizon, depicted with black ink strokes. In the foreground, there are trees depicted with varying line densities. A body of water can be seen in the background. The overall color palette is black-and-white.

artworks.title: Ma Belle Mere (Mother-in-Law)
artworks.description: The image depicts an older woman seated, shown from the waist up. Her hands are clasped in her lap. She has a wrinkled face and short, somewhat disheveled hair. She wears a detailed, textured garment with a shawl draped over her shoulders. The background has sketched lines, abstract patterns, and shapes suggesting an interior space.

artworks.title: Der Walchensee (The Walchensee)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated perspective overlooking a valley. Mountains partially obscure the horizon, with dark trees on the slopes and a body of water in the center. The expressive brushstrokes create texture, and the monochromatic color palette consists of black and white tones. The scene includes a rugged terrain with scattered trees, a fence, and swirling cloud formations in the sky.

artworks.title: Frauenräuber (Rape)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals and a horse. The drawing includes a horse in the foreground with deeply etched lines and shading to convey movement and mass. Surrounding the horse are figures depicted in dynamic strokes, suggesting interaction and narrative. The use of line and shading gives the scene an animated quality, capturing a moment of action with strong contrasts and expressions.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis im Strohhut (Self-Portrait in a Straw Hat)
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a man seated, facing mostly forward with a slight turn to the left. He has a mustache and rugged features, with his eyes looking to the right. He wears a hat, a coat, a black shirt, and holds a pipe in his left hand. The man's right hand is resting. The background is plain, emphasizing the man.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis im Strohhut (Self-Portrait in a Straw Hat)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a man from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The man's facial features include a pronounced mustache and deep-set eyes, and his hair is covered by a hat. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a dark band and a collared coat, buttoned at the top. The background is plain and unadorned, putting full focus on the man. A signature is visible at the bottom edge of the artwork.

artworks.title: Strasse in Königsberg (Street in Königsberg)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view overlooking a curving street with a prominent building in the distance. The brushstrokes are swift and expressive, likely drawn with charcoal or a similar medium. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of shades of black, gray, and off-white. The street curves with buildings on the right and trees on the left, leading towards a spire in the background.

artworks.title: Die Versuchung des heiligen Antonius (The Temptation of Saint Anthony)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in various poses. The central figure is tall and upright, surrounded by others in different stances. The style includes strong lines and a sense of movement, with dramatic gestures and expressions. The etching technique adds texture and dynamism to the drawing, creating a narrative or dramatic scene with emotional impact.

artworks.title: Donkey at a Watering Place (L'Ane a l'abreuvoir)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an eye-level point of view, capturing a serene riverbank scene. A line of tall, slender trees extends along the relatively low horizon line. The artwork features delicate and sketchy brushstrokes creating texture in the foliage. The color palette consists of grays and soft blacks, giving a tranquil ambiance. Closest to us on the left are dense trees potentially providing shade. A calm river runs horizontally, reflecting the natural elements. A figure on the right leads a horse near the water. The sky is lightly shaded with sparse clouds, completing the riverside scene.

artworks.title: Large Sheepfold (Le Grand parc a moutons)
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral scene with sheep resting and grazing. It is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a horizon line with a fence, distant trees, and a windmill on the far left. The etching utilizes fine lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. In the distance, birds fly in the sky. The scene conveys a sense of calm on a farm in the early morning.

artworks.title: The Meadow at Grave, near Villerville  (Le Pre des Graves, a Villerville)
artworks.description: In this image, the point of view is from a slightly elevated position, showing a broad view of a pastoral landscape. The horizon is in the upper part of the image, revealing low hills or wooded areas, topped by a line of trees. The etching is detailed, with fine lines creating texture and depth through cross-hatching. The color palette is monochrome, using various shades of brown. In the foreground, there is undulating terrain with grazing animals, and in the distance, small ships can be seen on the horizon.

artworks.title: Satyr (Le Satyre)
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with a high horizon obscured by dense foliage and trees. The detailed etching style showcases fine lines capturing the texture of trees and vegetation realistically. A figure is shown walking near a stream, with tall trees in the background. The artwork uses a black and white color palette, creating a rich sense of depth and atmosphere in a monochromatic view.

artworks.title: The Banks of the Cousin (Les Bords du Cousin)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of a path and a small stream winding through a wooded area. Trees line the horizon, with one prominent tree in the center-left. Detailed strokes depict the foliage and textures in sepia and dark brown tones.

artworks.title: Sunset (Soleil couchant)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon, detailed sky with textured clouds, trees and open space. On the riverbank to the right, a figure stands with a cow. To the left are scattered trees and shrubs. The fine lines create a tranquil atmosphere in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Ce logement est un peu cher, pour la place Royale...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a conversation or confrontation within an interior setting. The drawing depicts two individuals: one wearing a robe and slippers, and the other dressed in formal attire with a top hat, holding an umbrella behind his back. They are situated near a window with ornate detailing. The figure in the robe appears surprised or alarmed, while the figure in the hat leans forward. The scene is rendered in a style reminiscent of 19th-century sketches, characterized by its monochromatic shading and emphasis on line work. The play of light and shadow creates a dramatic atmosphere, focusing attention on the expressions and body language of the individuals.

artworks.title: Désagrément d'aller a la pêche...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angler holding a fishing rod while swatting at a swarm of insects. The scene depicts a person sitting on a rocky ledge by the water's edge, focused on fishing. The individual is holding a fishing rod with one hand while using the other hand and a piece of cloth or a hat to wave away a cloud of small insects. Beside the person, there is a fishing basket and other small items. The background includes a body of water with a landscape of distant land and possibly two small figures on the bank. The drawing captures the moment with expressive lines and shading, focusing on the interaction between the angler's calm patience and the disturbance from nature.

artworks.title: Les Suites d'une insurrection
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals: one kneeling on the floor and the other standing. The kneeling person wears a robe-like garment and a large paper hat with pointed ears. The standing individual has short, dark hair, a prominent nose and brow, and wears a dark coat and striped trousers. The background features seated figures, possibly children, resting their heads on a desk-like structure.

artworks.title: Hunting Dogs
artworks.description: In the foreground, two large animals are resting on the ground. One is lying down, and the other is curled beside it. Behind them, a stack of wooden logs or fencing leans against a makeshift barrier composed of vertical wooden slats. A small pile of additional material and some farming tools are visible to the right side of the scene. The overall color palette is composed of muted tones, predominantly shades of brown and off-white. The reclining animals are positioned near the lower-left corner, with the wooden fence and additional objects extending towards the center. A figure appears small in the background on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Two Mules
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up drawing of two heavily-laden horses adorned with decorative elements. In the background, a man is directing other burdened horses. The horizon is low in the frame, emphasizing the expansive sky above. The sky features faint cloud details. The artwork is characterized by intricate etching with fine lines used for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with strong contrast between dark lines and lighter areas suggesting sunlight and shadow.

artworks.title: The Dream of the Doctor (Temptation of the Idler)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.5 x 11.8 cm (7 5/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a scholar robed as a doctor seated at right on an elevated bench, slumped against a pile of pillows, fast asleep. In front of him stands a tower of carved blocks evidently architected with deliberate care. Behind and to his left, a demonic, bat-winged figure aims the nozzle of a bellows at his unguarded ear. In the foreground at left, a standing nude female figure gazes intently at him while gesturing with an outstretched hand. At lower right, a cherubic child with angel’s wings attempts to mount a pair of stilts while gazing down toward the floor, where a small, unadorned globe rests.

artworks.title: A Star Falls and Makes Hell to Open
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 30.5 × 21.7 cm (12 × 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a detailed scene with various figures and angels surrounding a central figure. The composition is filled with intertwined human forms and mythical creatures, with the central figure seated prominently at the top. Some figures have wings, while others appear to be struggling. Many figures are shown in dynamic poses with vivid expressions. The bottom half of the image shows a grouping of figures with various actions and expressions. The scene likely draws inspiration from religious or mythological narratives, with rich symbolism and storytelling detail in the clothing and facial features.

artworks.title: The Multitude Which Stands before the Throne
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 30.5 × 21.5 cm (12 × 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts numerous figures in a heavenly scene. It shows intricate robes and wings on the figures. At the top center, two prominent figures sit on a throne surrounded by other beings looking upwards. Below, there are arches and colonnades suggesting a grand setting. The figures are detailed with expressive faces and elaborate garments, enhancing the sense of majesty and divinity in the artwork.

artworks.title: The Babylon Harlot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 30.3 x 21.7 cm (11 15/16 x 8 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed biblical scene with mythical creatures and architectural structures. The foreground shows a figure in a decorated robe interacting with a multi-headed beast. The background includes buildings, a waterway, and celestial figures emerging from clouds. The drawing is rich in intricate details and energy, reminiscent of Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Saint John Summoned to Heaven
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.2 × 21.5 cm (11 7/8 × 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing depicting a complex, symbolic scene with numerous figures and mythical creatures. The composition portrays a scene of divine judgment or revelation. At the top, a central figure sits on a throne surrounded by various figures, some possibly angels, and mythical creatures like lambs and eagles. The central figure has a large halo and is surrounded by characters and beings with different expressions and gestures.

Below, there are crowned and robed figures, some with detailed headwear indicating positions of power. Clouds or smoke create the base of the scene, giving depth to the composition. Architectural elements are visible in the lower portion, suggesting a cityscape.

The drawing features intricate line work and shading, creating a detailed narrative landscape filled with symbolic elements. Light and dark contrasts enhance the drawing's intensity and drama. The work conveys a narrative rich in iconography, potentially inspired by religious texts.
